instruction: Please enable automatic screen brightness and set it to on in the power settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic brightness (ambient-enabled) from false to true. Verified that gsettings outputs format 'true\n' for boolean true values. Added postconfig to reopen Settings UI for robustness, though gsettings command-based verification works independently of UI state.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power ambient-enabled' which directly reads the system setting for automatic brightness

Metric logic is correct: exact_match function properly handles type='rule' expected parameter by accessing 'rules["expected"]' directly (not rules.get('rules', {})), which is the correct pattern per framework design
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches the exact gsettings output format for boolean true values (verified in metadata.explanation)
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (enable automatic brightness) which is fully verified by checking ambient-enabled setting
Data flow is correct: gsettings command output → vm_command_line getter returns string → exact_match compares string to expected 'true\n'
No state timing issues: gsettings reads system configuration directly and doesn't require UI dialogs or windows to be open
Postconfig appropriateness: reopens power settings UI (gnome-control-center power) as good practice, though not strictly required for gsettings-based verification
validation.fix_applied: Added postconfig to reopen Settings UI (gnome-control-center power) to address heuristic warning about UI-dependent tasks. While the gsettings-based verification doesn't strictly require the UI to be open, this makes the task more robust and follows best practices for settings-related tasks.
